bounded_wal_observation.checkpoint_cadence: one PASSIVE checkpoint per 256 successful grid records

control_diagnostic.outer_record_timing_note: The wrapper performs each checkpoint before record_grid_decision returns; the frozen base outer wall/thread-CPU sample and histogram therefore include checkpoint time, while CHECKPOINT is also counted as its own SQL phase.

settings.base_self_check_compatibility: The base checks WAL/FULL and equality of pragma snapshots, but does not require the default autocheckpoint value; replay and reopen both observe zero, so the existing equality check remains intact.
settings.changed_pragma_only: PRAGMA wal_autocheckpoint=0 on each new output journal connection
settings.payload_source_and_validation: frozen base replay unchanged; all reopened payload rows must match

timing.sample_scope: new 100k replay; ordinals are not attributed to the earlier formal max call
timing.wrapper_note: Connection/Cursor execute wrappers add diagnostic overhead; not formal performance evidence.
